original_bug_mechanism: Time-source changes remove still-needed neighbor transmit links and discard queued packets.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: Neighbor transmit cells retain their links but omit LINK_OPTION_SHARED, disabling the shared-cell contention policy.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. Neighbor transmit cells retain their links but omit LINK_OPTION_SHARED, disabling the shared-cell contention policy.
oracle: A newly added neighbor must have a transmit link marked both TX and SHARED. Existing time-source, queue-lifetime, and receive-cell tests must remain passing.
realism: Omitting a link-option flag when creating scheduler cells is a localized configuration mistake; this differs from link deletion.
test_changes: Minimal additions to the existing regression suite; original tests and assertions preserved.
